requirements.title: Utility, territory, customer class, service voltage and eligibility
requirements.boundary: Geography is not evidence of eligibility; class/voltage metadata needs source-level preservation

requirements.title: Effective dates, filing revision, approval and supersession
requirements.boundary: Current tariff may have riders changed after base schedule

requirements.title: Energy/TOU/tier rates and adjustments
requirements.boundary: Imported billing units kWh; distinguish component price from delivered all-in price

requirements.title: Season, weekday, hour and holiday schedules
requirements.boundary: Integer-hour windows; holiday/day-class exceptions need explicit treatment

requirements.title: Demand window, TOU peak and facility demand
requirements.boundary: 15/30/60-minute demand requires original-resolution load, not an hourly mean

requirements.title: Contracted capacity, minimum billing demand and service commitments
requirements.boundary: Actual contracted entitlement and billing-demand floor are not inferred from connected MW

requirements.title: Ratchet share, lookback and history
requirements.boundary: Imported ratchet subset only; missing history is not a zero peak

requirements.title: Fixed customer/meter/day fees
requirements.boundary: Annual fixed fees may be divided by 12 only with disclosed convention

requirements.title: Transmission/distribution, riders, levies, taxes and wholesale pass-through
requirements.boundary: Do not double count embedded transmission or treat retail average as a component schedule

requirements.title: Coincident peak, Ontario Class A/ICI and capacity contributions
requirements.boundary: Current URDB importer refuses coincidentrate fields; five-system-peak cost is not monthly site peak

requirements.title: Minimum bill, standby, reactive/kVA and excess demand
requirements.boundary: URDB importer refuses minimum bills and non-kW demand; generic tariff schema is not proof of billing support

requirements.title: Export/net billing, avoided cost and injection charges
requirements.boundary: URDB sell tiers refused; distinct export price route does not establish a full net-metering scheme

requirements.title: Connection, non-firm access and one-time reinforcement
requirements.boundary: Customer-specific connection cost and contractual import limit need actual agreement

requirements.title: Fuel/power-cost adjustment and dynamic retail supply
requirements.boundary: Effective component series versus tariff rider must be reconciled to avoid double billing

requirements.title: Rate choices for data centres, industrial sites and renewable IPPs
requirements.boundary: Large-load service, interruptible/minimum term and credit requirements stay source-specific

requirements.title: Operator, system, node/hub/zone and market regime
requirements.boundary: Current MarketRegion enum supports only US_ERCOT/US_PJM/US_CAISO/CA_ON in NAM; raw series storage is broader than market-product execution

requirements.title: DA/RT/imbalance product and price components
requirements.boundary: Separate energy, congestion, losses, scarcity/adders; do not sum total LMP and components

requirements.title: Interval length, hour ending/start and timestamps
requirements.boundary: Preserve UTC offset/DST fold/time-standard rules; naive timestamp plus timezone is refused by series parser

requirements.title: Currency, price units and FX valuation basis
requirements.boundary: FinanceInputs and Participant carry currency; SeriesMeta carries unit/source_unit; PriceSeriesRef has no dedicated currency/unit and several commercial fields remain EUR-named. Prove end-to-end USD/CAD/MXN valuation and semantic pinning; do not relabel values.

requirements.title: Finality, revisions, missing/duplicate intervals and coverage
requirements.boundary: Newest publication is not always final; missing prices are not zero

requirements.title: Negative and extreme prices and validity flags
requirements.boundary: Retain signs and source status; do not clip to positive prices

requirements.title: Historical spot vs futures/forwards and scenario curves
requirements.boundary: Historical data does not establish an actionable forward quote

requirements.title: Ancillary/reserve/DR/capacity products and performance terms
requirements.boundary: Prices alone do not establish accreditation, dispatch feasibility or simultaneous revenue eligibility

requirements.title: Ontario renewed market, legacy HOEP and Global Adjustment
requirements.boundary: Keep pre/post-May-2025 regimes separate; OEMP/LMP/HOEP are not interchangeable

requirements.title: Mexico nodal PML components, system and time basis
requirements.boundary: SIN/BCA/BCS and regional DST rules; pesos per MWh are not dollars per MWh

requirements.title: Wholesale fuel and carbon/certificate benchmarks
requirements.boundary: Heating value, delivered vs hub price, regional carbon scheme and certificate attribute must be retained

requirements.title: Fixed price, strike, premium and observation vintage
requirements.boundary: Public awards and historical samples are benchmarks, not current signed bilateral offers

requirements.title: Start/commissioning date, tenor and delivery year
requirements.boundary: Base money/index year is not a full delivery-start schedule

requirements.title: Pay-as-produced/baseload/consumption profile, share and volume
requirements.boundary: Generation share, annual cap and fixed notional are different volume risks

requirements.title: Physical/financial settlement, buyer/seller and asset binding
requirements.boundary: Financial PPA native validator allows fixed-price pay_as_produced only; not a general swap engine

requirements.title: Reference hub/node, basis and capture-price calculation
requirements.boundary: Node-to-hub basis, monthly capture and delivery location cannot be assumed equal

requirements.title: Escalation, nominal/real basis and base year
requirements.boundary: Levelized PPA benchmark differs from first-year price; retain discount/escalation basis

requirements.title: Caps/floors, negative-price suspension and curtailment
requirements.boundary: Native financial PPA refuses floor/cap; contractual curtailment compensation not implied

requirements.title: Sleeving, shaping, imbalance, losses and network charges
requirements.boundary: Named EUR fields and incomplete balancing-risk scope need currency-aware admission

requirements.title: REC/GO/CEL/environmental attribute ownership
requirements.boundary: Price may bundle certificates/tax value; no automatic claim of hourly matching or green hydrogen certification

requirements.title: Credit, collateral, guarantees, termination and legal terms
requirements.boundary: No generic credit-risk/collateral/termination engine; document as unsupported contract terms

requirements.title: Public contract files, awards, transaction observations and publication bias
requirements.boundary: Public SEC/FERC filings and awards may omit prices/clauses; legal text rights separate from price facts

requirements.title: Hydrogen/ammonia off-take, support and industrial product prices
requirements.boundary: Delivered product price, support premium and modelled break-even value are separate; exact native product bindings reviewed separately

requirements.title: Wind/PV/storage/H2 CapEx, FOM/VOM and cost projections
requirements.boundary: Source money year, capacity basis, component inclusion and actual operating vintage separate

requirements.title: Maintenance, replacements, degradation and warranty
requirements.boundary: Model-class benchmark is not a calibrated equipment/CMMS law

requirements.title: Inflation/escalation and price indices
requirements.boundary: Keep index, currency, real/nominal basis and money year explicit

requirements.title: FX historical conversion and scenario convention
requirements.boundary: Raw/derived value lineage and trade date; never relabel currencies

requirements.title: Risk-free rates, WACC, debt terms and fees
requirements.boundary: Sovereign yield is not a project WACC, lending quote or calibrated credit spread

requirements.title: Tax, depreciation and incentives
requirements.boundary: Current law, eligibility, geography and service date; do not assume a project qualifies

requirements.title: Source identity, exact release/row and original document
requirements.boundary: Hash source evidence and transformation rules; link source clauses/cells

requirements.title: Rights for commercial use, cache, derivatives, display/export and common scope
requirements.boundary: Publicly reachable does not establish reuse permission; source obligations propagate

requirements.title: Applicability, uncertainty, actual/benchmark/synthetic and missing data
requirements.boundary: Keep customer facts private; refuse unsupported/missing inputs instead of fabricating defaults

requirements.title: Retrieval limits, credentials and private-data isolation
requirements.boundary: No API keys inside library payloads; fixed reviewed endpoints, bounded retrieval and tenant scope
